title: Implant purpose and bloodline hybrid program

tellings.quote: Um that it was a medical monitoring device is my understanding uh to or monitor things like blood sugar and body temperature and things like that.

plain: Steve Coburn, a scientist who studies objects he believes are alien implants in human bodies, told podcast host Jesse Michels what he thinks such an implant is for. His understanding is that it was a medical monitoring device, tracking things like blood sugar and body temperature, and the story ties this to the idea of a program watching certain family bloodlines for breeding human-alien hybrids. If true, it would mean some people are being medically monitored by non-humans.
